cohort: The study included pregnant women with and without epilepsy, some of whom were using antiseizure medication (ASM), enrolled in the Norwegian Mother, Father, and Child Cohort Study.
finding: More pregnant women with epilepsy reported emotional, physical, and sexual abuse than women without epilepsy, and in nulliparous women with ASM-untreated epilepsy, experiencing abuse was significantly associated with fear of childbirth.
